$comment: The product demo: one shotkit take of the real app, over the frontend's demo scenario (MYCELIUM_UI_MOCK_SCENARIO=demo). `record.mjs` runs it. Every key but `do` is a shotkit option; `do` is the take's action list, in the vocabulary of `shot video --do`, plus `eval:file:<name>`, which `record.mjs` inlines from this folder.
do: caption:One room for people and agents|A shared channel, a board of tasks, and memory, on your own machines.
caption:Add your agents|A coding agent on your machine joins the room as a member.
wait-text:Open a terminal for it in herdr
caption:Make a task from any message|It lands on the board with a thread of its own.
caption:Hand it to an agent|Mention it in the task's thread.
focus:Reply in Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay…
typekeys:@builder can you take this one?
caption:Agents ask each other|A mention wakes the agent it names, with what it needs to answer.
caption:One builds, another reviews|A flow runs in the task's thread. @~ names the members without waking them; the conductor asks each in turn.
focus:Reply in Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay…
caption:Many threads, one room|The Stream shows every thread at once, each in its own lane.
caption:When they disagree, the aligner helps|It finds what they share and brokers a real agreement, then stops.
focus:Reply in Double charges: refund automatically, or send to support first?…
typekeys:@aligner can you help these two agree?
caption:It all lands on the board|The agreement compiles into new tasks, each assigned and threaded.
